title: Close all Fourier residue blocks for the same steady field and unequal diffusivities
statement: For b=n A0 v(nx),n=R^200,A0=R^100, Fourier residue spaces q mod n are orthogonal and invariant. The q=0 mean-zero block contracts by exp(-4pi^2 kappa_i n^2t). Blocks |q|>R^2 contract by diffusion with exponent>=4pi^2 R^2. On0<|q|<=R^2 set eta=2pi q/n and microscopic tau=n^2t; |eta|<=7R^-198,beta<=7R^-98<=kappa_i and A0*10^12 M^-30/kappa_i<=10^12R^-79<1. The Bloch bound is <=2exp[-R^150/(4*10^60)]<=2exp(-R)<=1/R<=epsilon for R>=9. Thus every supplied S_i(t) has full mean-zero L2 operator norm<=epsilon for the SAME stationary field.
